description: Enterprise HPP (Harga Pokok Produksi) & R&D Packaging ERP System tailored for PT Balagi Rattan (Cirebon, Indonesia), blending natural warm artisanal rattan tones with dense, high-efficiency Swiss engineering grids for multi-category BOM calculation, labor rate indexing (2014-2026), buyer import, and print-ready technical sheets.

guidelines.number_formatting: Always use Indonesian Rupiah format (e.g., Rp 1.450.000 or Rp 12.500) and Indonesian decimal format (,). Use IBM Plex Mono for all numeric tables, currency, dimensions (TW/TD/TH in mm), and volume calculations to preserve tabular digit alignment.
guidelines.headings: Use Outfit font with tracking-tight and semi-bold weight for section cards and sheet headers.

entry_surfaces./: split branded dashboard — sidebar navigation left with Balagi logo, dense KPI tiles and cost calculation workbench right
entry_surfaces./login: split branded login — warm craft wood photography with Balagi Rattan heritage left, secure credential panel with role switcher (Admin, Marketing, R&D) right

layouts.app_shell: Two-column ERP layout: 240px fixed dark walnut sidebar (`bg-[#1E1A16]`) on desktop, collapsible on mobile; sticky header with active buyer context, quick currency toggles (IDR / USD estimation), user role indicator, and quick actions (+ New HPP, + Import Excel, + Packaging Spec); main content viewport with fluid dense padding (`p-6`).
layouts.hpp_form_layout: Excel-fidelity multi-section workbench: Header Metadata Card (Item Code, Buyer, Color, Model, Dimensions TW/TD/TH mm, Date, Reference Image) -> Interactive Section Accordions/Tables (1. Material Rattan/Wood, 2. Additional Material, 3. Finishing, 4. Packing, 5. Cushion & Foam, 6. Upah Kerja / Labor with Year Picker, 7. Out Sourcing) -> Sticky Bottom Cost Summary Bar (Total Net Cost, Rounding Factor, HPP +32% Profit Margin, FOB Price Estimate).
layouts.packaging_form_layout: Standardized R&D Packaging Technical Spec matching physical Indonesian factory form: Buyer/PO/ETD info -> Complement Checkboxes (Cushion, Glass, Hardware) -> Box Configuration (No Box / With Box: Polyfoam, Single Face, Kraft 100/150/200/275 lbs, Pcs/Box A1/A2) -> Corner & Edge Protect Checklist -> Marking/Shipping Label status -> Signatures Block (Marketing, Dibuat R&D, Mengetahui R&D Head).
layouts.labor_matrix_layout: Year-over-year % wage matrix (2014-2026) in an editable dense spreadsheet grid with live recalculations across historical HPP references.
layouts.report_analytics_layout: Bento dashboard with Buyer Cost Matrix chart, Monthly HPP Trend, Material Category Spend Breakdown (Recharts), and searchable exportable table (PDF & Excel download).

motion.transitions: transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease

accessibility.data_testids: Mandatory data-testid on every button, input, tab, select, modal, and export action (e.g. data-testid="btn-add-material-row", data-testid="input-hpp-item-code", data-testid="btn-export-pdf").

login_craft_bg.description: Artisan hand-weaving natural rattan straw in traditional workshop, representing Balagi Rattan heritage.

rattan_texture_pattern.description: Close up geometric woven cane and wicker pattern for subtle banner and empty state textures.

workshop_craft_bench.description: Craftsman assembling furniture frame in production studio.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Seed Database with PT Balagi Rattan master materials (≈570 items classified into: Rattan, Webbing, Besi, Aluminium, Wood, Plywood, Kaca, Supplies, Finishing, Packing, Cushion, Upah Kerja, Out Sourcing) with standard Cirebon factory unit prices in IDR.
2. Seed labor wage matrix with years 2014 to 2026 containing yearly percentage adjustments and standard process hourly/daily unit rates (Rangka, Anyam, Amplas, Finishing, Packing).

3. Seed default calculations matching the 'Rattan Bench 1' benchmark sheet (Item Code: RB-001, Buyer: Sika Design / Vincent Sheppard / Pottery Barn, Dimensions: TW 1200mm, TD 450mm, TH 850mm, with calculated Net Cost, Rounding, and 32% HPP markup).
4. Build a responsive live Excel upload parser in FastAPI (`openpyxl` / `pandas`) supporting buyer Excel files and auto-generating the linked HPP record and R&D Packaging Spec form.
5. Provide one-click print and high-fidelity PDF export for both the HPP Calculation Sheet and the R&D Packaging Form (with signatures block).
6. Provide Role-Based Access Control (Admin, Marketing, R&D) with instant user switching or login so all workflows can be tested directly.
7. Include all required `data-testid` attributes on inputs, buttons, rows, tabs, and export triggers for clean automated verification.
